Aging
CARE Nursing Home Pre-Admission Screening
CARE stands for Client Assessment, Referral and Evaluation. Everyone seeking a permanent move to a Kansas Medicaid certified nursing facility must be assessed by the CARE program.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Caregiver Support and Counseling
The Area Agency on Aging sponsors services to educate, counsel and advise caregivers and help them deal with the physical and emotional stresses of caregiving. Other services provide direct care for the older adults to assist the caregiver or give the caregiver a much needed break.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Catch-a-Ride Volunteer Transportation
Catch-a-Ride is a social service program that provides volunteer transportation to medical appointments and social service agencies within Johnson County.
-->
Aging and Human Services
CHAMPSS Meal Program for Seniors
The Johnson County Area Agency on Aging (AAA) Nutrition Program is pleased to offer a dining opportunity called CHAMPSS, a program for adults 60 years or older and their spouses at certain Hy-Vee grocery stores.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Explore Your Options Service Directory
A compact, comprehensive, one-stop resource for online services and information specific to seniors and individuals with a disability in Johnson County.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Home-Delivered Meals for Seniors
Johnson County Area Agency on Aging provides home-delivered meals to homebound residents, age 60+, and their spouse.
-->
Aging and Human Services
In-Home Services for Seniors
In-home services provide support for older adults who need services to maintain independent living.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Information and Referral Services for Seniors
The Johnson County Area Agency on Aging offers a single point of entry for services for older adults. Information specialists are your starting point for locating resources such as in-home services, congregate and home-delivered meals, transportation, legal assistance, insurance, housing and more.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Medicaid/KanCare Aging and Disability Resource Center
Aging & Disability Resource Centers, or ADRCs, are visible and trusted places where people can turn for information, assistance on public long-term support programs and benefits, especially Medicaid or KanCare in Kansas.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Neighborhood Center Meals for Seniors
The Johnson County Area Agency on Aging provides nutritious meals at six Neighborhood Centers. In addition, Neighborhood Centers offer a variety of services, activities and educational programs for older individuals in the community.
-->
Aging and Human Services
Outreach Nurse Services for Older Adults
Skilled Registered Nurses are available to visit with senior adults one on one in their home and provide physical and social assessments as well as education and counseling on senior needs.
-->

Park and Recreation 50 Plus Program
JCPRD’s 50 Plus Program provides unique opportunities and lifelong memories that inspire a healthier community.
-->
Park and Recreation
SHICK/Medicare Insurance Counseling
SHICK (Senior Health Insurance Counseling for Kansas) is a program offering older Kansans an opportunity to talk with trained community volunteers about Medicare and other health insurance programs.
-->
Aging and Human Services
The Best Times News Magazine for Seniors
The Best Times - is a bi-monthly newsmagazine for Johnson County residents who are 60 or older.
-->

Bus and Ride Share Services
Johnson County Transit provides public transportation throughout Johnson County, connecting to downtown Kansas City, Missouri, and Kansas City, Kansas.

Property Tax Appraisal Process
An appraisal is the method established by Kansas statute to determine a property owner’s share of the taxes that support schools, roads, health and human service programs, parks, and police and fire protection.

Treasury, Taxation and Vehicles
Commercial Sewer Permits
Johnson County Wastewater's commercial permitting team reviews and inspects commercial building plans and plumbing in accordance with our regulations. Find requirements and apply for commercial permits.
-->
Wastewater
Food Service Permits
Johnson County Wastewater's food service permitting team regulates and monitors the pumping and maintenance of grease interceptors and establishes best management practices to prevent sewer backups caused by fats, oils and grease. Apply for food service permits.
-->
Wastewater
Industrial Sewer Permits
Johnson County Wastewater's Industrial Pretreatment Program regulates industrial wastewater discharges so that toxic materials do not interfere with wastewater treatment systems or pass through to receiving streams. Find requirements and apply for industrial permits.
-->
Wastewater
Sewer Use Credit
Enroll in Johnson County's Sewer Use Credit, a voluntary program for commercial customers who install a deduct meter for water not entering the sanitary sewer.
-->

Sustainability Consulting
Johnson County Department of Health and Environment staff provide free waste diversion assistance and sustainability consulting to businesses, schools, restaurants and other commercial entities. Qualifying organizations may be eligible to receive up to $500 in supplies to assist in waste reduction efforts.
